Create Patient.description: Creates a Patient resource in a Cloud Healthcare FHIR store.

Create Encounter.description: Logs a facility visit as an Encounter resource.

Create Observation.description: Stores a lab result or vital sign as an Observation resource.

Create Immunization.description: Records a vaccine dose as an Immunization resource.

Create Condition.description: Records a diagnosis as a Condition resource.

Create Resources For Each Record.description: Loops over a list of records and creates one Patient per item.
